name: claude-session-explorer
description: Claude Session Explorer — root workspace. One-command install/run for the Indexer + Visualizer (CR-PROC-04). Each package's own dev workflow (cd indexer|visualizer && npm run dev) is unchanged.

scripts.start:indexer: npm run build -w indexer && npm run start -w indexer
scripts.start:visualizer: npm run build -w visualizer && npm run preview -w visualizer -- --port 5173
